method: Clip each already inward-rounded bounded domain with exact rational arithmetic. Remove an empty continuous domain, or map a domain to an already retained domain in the identical orientation class and sheet only if every rational source vertex satisfies every target integer halfspace and bound. Every allowed coordinate is preserved. Process by descending continuous area for useful supersets; the order is not an acceptance condition. Stop containment comparisons at30seconds or500000, keep all remaining domains and do not extend. Independently reconstruct every empty or replaced source domain from pairwise boundary-line intersections and verify its full target inequalities. Because domains are bounded convex polyhedra, vertices certify whole-domain containment. No solver or pose generation.
